stories.title: Selective depletion of AMH-expressing granulosa cells in vivo impairs follicular development and fertility in female mice
stories.body: In mammals, ovarian follicle development is a highly coordinated process that underlies female fertility. Granulosa cells expressing anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) are widely used as a marker of growing follicles.
